# One-time: Seal the Calicut Spice Charter (hard gold & prestige cost; connects Malabar hub).
oe_sea_dec_calicut_charter = {
    decision_category = economy_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        oe_sea_participant = yes
        current_year >= 1380
        OR = {
            owns = location:kozhikode
            owns = location:goa
            oe_sea_roman_company_active = yes
            oe_sea_yuan_shibosi_active = yes
        }
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sea_dec_calicut_done } NOT = { var:oe_sea_dec_calicut_done = 1 } }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 200
        stability >= 0
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_sea_dec_calicut_charter.a
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_sea_dec_calicut_done value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_signatory value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_malabar_charter value = 2 }
            add_gold = -200
            add_prestige = -5
            oe_sea_upgrade_malabar_port = yes
            oe_sea_apply_corridor_partners = { bias = oe_sea_b_malabar_charter mod = oe_sea_calicut_charter_mod yrs = 30 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sea_calicut_charter_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
            oe_sea_update_corridor = yes
            oe_sea_sync_corridor_tier = yes
        }
    }
}

# Repeatable (15-year cooldown): Dispatch a Monsoon Silk Road Convoy (requires corridor_level >= 1).
oe_sea_dec_monsoon_fleet = {
    decision_category = economy_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_sea_participant = yes
        current_year >= 1410
        has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level } global_var:oe_sea_corridor_level >= 1 }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 160
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_sea_convoy_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:soldiers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_sea_dec_monsoon_fleet.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -160
            set_variable = { name = oe_sea_convoy_cd months = 180 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_signatory value = 1 }
            add_navy_tradition = 6
            oe_sea_update_corridor = yes
            oe_sea_sync_corridor_tier = yes
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sea_monsoon_convoy_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}
